newsitem.title: CANADA: CanOxy confirms new Yemen Masila oil find.
newsitem.headline: CanOxy confirms new Yemen Masila oil find.

text.p: Canadian Occidental Petroleum Ltd confirmed on Thursday it made a new field discovery on its Masila oil concession in Yemen, but did not verify reported production levels.

Yemen's deputy minister of oil was quoted earlier as saying the discovery -- called the Dahban field -- was pumping at a rate of 12,000 barrels a day and an official inauguration would take place shortly.
"My information is that it will be tested later this month, but I'm currently checking," CanOxy spokesman Kevin Finn said.
The Masila Block, in which CanOxy is operator and owns 52 percent, has been the company's most successful international venture and a major contributor to its production since 1993.
Total output from Masila is currently averaging between 185,000 and 190,000 barrels a day and Finn said production had climbed occasionally above 200,000 barrels a day.
Other Masila partners include Occidental Petroleum Corp with 20 percent, Royal Dutch/Shell Group unit Shell Pecten with 20 percent and a Middle East-based construction firm with the balance.
CanOxy shares jumped 0.75 to 33.25 in early Toronto Stock Exchange trade after the discovery report on Thursday.
